items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Topics 49:1
items.html: (To the question) Because at the time that Rachel and Leah are two Partzufim, ZA then has only the Mochin of SAG and Neshama, which are the aspect of covered Hassadim, and then ZA and Rachel are in the aspect of back-to-back, namely, that the feet of Leah spread into the territory of Rachel and conceal the aspect of her NHY, her house, and only their faces are revealed, which is the aspect of the covered Hassadim that Rachel receives from ZA, which is considered the aspect of HGT, as above. And it is discerned that if Leah did not spread into the territory of Rachel, then the NHY of Rachel would be revealed, which are the aspect of the need for revealed Hassadim. And in this they would be found longer than the NHY of ZA, for the NHY of ZA are discerned as short, being from the aspect of the Mochin of Ima, whose aspect of the Yesod is wide and short; but the NHY of Rachel, if they were revealed, would be attributed to the posteriors of the Yesod of Aba, which are from the aspect of the Yesod of Aba, which is narrow and long. And therefore there is a necessity that the Keter of Rachel should clothe on the feet of Leah and receive the aspect of the posteriors of Ima, from the Yesod of Ima, which is short, through which the NHY of Rachel are found in the internality, and the long aspect of Aba is not noticeable in her; and then Rachel is equal with ZA, and is not longer than him. And understand. (Item 25).
